releaseNotes:
- Rayence: send the whole exposure config, and the exposure the caller asked for
- NOVO: talk to the panel's real address, and open the channel the way it opens
- Make the log usable when something goes wrong
- Report exposure state and the real panel name in the X-ray dialog
- Rayence: key acquisition completion on ImageReady, not ExposureDone
- Fix Rayence acquisition: one connection at a time, match reference capture
- Add step-by-step logging to Rayence acquisition
- Add Nova/Trixell Pixium 3543EZ panel support (RADII-PANEL-003)
- Read Rayence calibration by real Logos file names
- Fix annotation label combobox: empty default, 5-item dropdown, click-to-select
- Load Rayence calibration from Logos MONOS folder by serial
- Support multiple technicians per job (desktop)
- Add annotation labels: Data Room management page and in-editor combobox
- Redesign image file system: per-project folders, readable names, safer delete
- Only take one pre-restore backup per day
- Back up the current database before restoring
- Match report-export ruler and annotations to local export
- Point NOVO import default path to the real NOVOX location
- Auto-detect the connected panel instead of manual selection
- Add automatic DB backup on every launch with restore-from-list dialog
- Configuration dialog styling and simulator sample for preview
- Panel Configuration dialog UI (phase 3)
- Vivex configuration write path (phase 2)
- Vivex configuration read path (phase 1)
- Vivex configuration model and IPanel surface (phase 0)
- Universal Import Images (Logos + NOVO) with Browse and direct-folder support
- Panel selection via Panel Settings dialog
- Rayence panel driver (protocol, flat-field calibration, IPanel)
